description: A modern, extensible Text User Interface (TUI) library for .NET that provides rich terminal UI components built on Spectre.Console. Create interactive console applications with styled text, borders, layouts, and keyboard input handling using clean, object-oriented APIs. Features modular architecture with dependency injection support, cross-platform compatibility, and comprehensive styling options for professional terminal applications.
releaseNotes:
## v2.1.0 (minor)

Changes since v2.0.0:

- Suppress package-validation errors on Polyfill's embedded types [patch] (#261) (matt-edmondson)
- Keep a CJK or emoji border title inside the border [patch] (#262) (matt-edmondson)
- Clip WriteAt text to the screen in cells, never splitting a character [patch] (#263) (matt-edmondson)
- Give a hidden root element no input [patch] (#267) (matt-edmondson)
- Normalise control characters in a border title like TextElement text [patch] (#250) (matt-edmondson)
- Keep a hidden container from drawing its children or passing them input [patch] (#251) (matt-edmondson)
- Leave a hidden child out of BorderElement's and the default container measure [patch] (#252) (matt-edmondson)
- [patch] Fault the run when a render pass throws a foreign OperationCanceledException (#253) (matt-edmondson)
- [patch] Measure a container with no room past its padding as the padding alone (#254) (matt-edmondson)
- Treat a negative padding side as 0 [patch] (#256) (matt-edmondson)
- Delete TUI.Cli, which no PR build compiled, and require every project in TUI.sln [patch] (#257) (matt-edmondson)
- Compile the showcase demo again and run it for --showcase [patch] (#258) (matt-edmondson)
- Let an element's render failure end the run instead of erasing the frame [patch] (#247) (matt-edmondson)
- Clear the screen when the root element is removed [patch] (#245) (matt-edmondson)
- Leave a collapsed child out of a horizontal StackPanel's measured height [patch] (#244) (matt-edmondson)
- Count a cancelled read from this run as a failed read instead of skipping it [patch] (#243) (matt-edmondson)
- Treat U+2028 and U+2029 as line breaks instead of writing a raw line feed [patch] (Claude)
- Type AltGr+C as a character instead of exiting [patch] (Claude)
- Draw styled text as written instead of parsing it as markup [patch] (Claude)
- Add UIApplication.Post to change the tree from another thread [minor] (Claude)
- Use BorderStyle.DoubleLine in the README Quick Start, and compile it in the tests [patch] (Claude)
- Move WrapText's line break into a helper to keep it under the complexity limit (Claude)
- Keep a paragraph's indentation when its first word has to be broken [patch] (Claude)
- End a run on OperationCanceledException only when the run was cancelled [patch] (Claude)
- Refuse a cyclic BorderElement.Child before detaching the old one [patch] (Claude)
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into claude/tui-167-refuse-cyclic-add (Claude)
- Guard the run's token source with a lock instead of catching ObjectDisposedException [patch] (Claude)
- Claim only the padding when wrapped text has no column to draw in [patch] (Claude)
- Dispose the token source each run links to the caller's token [patch] (Claude)
- Lay a swapped-back root out at the terminal's current size [patch] (Claude)
- Invalidate on layout property changes and re-arrange on a padding change [patch] (Claude)
- Refuse a second child in BorderElement [patch] (Claude)
- Refuse adding a container to itself or one of its descendants [patch] (Claude)
- Combine the nested input-not-handled check [patch] (Claude)
- Give the pending read up when a run ends, so the next key is not swallowed [patch] (Claude)
- Wrap text inside a border or a horizontal stack to the width it gets [patch] (Claude)
- test: cover OffsetConsoleProvider and invisible elements in Render (Claude)
- Move the control-character helper and its provider tests to the end of their files (Claude)
- fix: draw an element at the position passed to IConsoleProvider.Render [patch] (Claude)
- fix: draw changes made outside a keypress by redrawing when the tree invalidates [patch] (Claude)
- fix: expand tabs and replace control characters in text before measuring and drawing [patch] (Claude)
- fix: stretch StackPanel children across the cross axis so alignment applies [patch] (Claude)
- fix: measure a titled BorderElement wide enough to draw its title [patch] (Claude)
- [patch] Leave the terminal's color for a transparent foreground or background (Claude)
- test: drive ReadInputAsync through an injected key reader [patch] (Claude)
- Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into fix/152-keychar (Claude)
- test: cover Ctrl+C and plain C in ToInputResult [patch] (Claude)
- fix: pass the typed character through with each key [patch] (Claude)
- fix: keep a BorderElement title with a line break on the top border row [patch] (Claude)
- fix: hide and show the cursor on the injected console without moving it [patch] (Claude)
- fix: arrange the tree on every render pass, not only on a resize [patch] (Claude)
- refactor: move overlong-word slicing out of WrapText [patch] (Claude)
- fix: keep indentation and spacing when TextElement wraps words [patch] (Claude)
- fix: invalidate each ancestor once instead of 2^depth times [patch] (Claude)
- test: cover the ArgumentException read-failure path [patch] (matt-edmondson)
- fix: end the run after repeated failed reads instead of spinning forever [patch] (matt-edmondson)
